subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR be allowed to treat legacy no-pluginId, no-code diagnostics with missing absolute sources as stale at runtime, or should that upgrade cleanup live in doctor/migration instead?
rationale: The explicit marker path follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy fallback changes upgrade behavior for persisted SQLite diagnostics that cannot carry the new marker.

options.title: Require latest-head legacy proof
options.body: Keep the runtime fallback but require redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds before merge.

options.title: Accept source and test proof
options.body: Merge with the current tests and PR-body summary, knowingly waiving stronger external proof for upgraded persisted state.

options.title: Move legacy cleanup to migration
options.body: Pause or revise the PR so legacy no-code row cleanup is handled by doctor/migration rather than steady-state runtime invalidation.

recommendation.title: Require latest-head legacy proof
recommendation.body: Keep the runtime fallback but require redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the relevant stale-diagnostic and SQLite plugin-index history and is best positioned to decide the upgrade/runtime boundary.
